score_semantics: Relative admission score, not a probability of proof. Repetition and current-resolution gates override the numerical score.

budget.interpretation: One bounded portfolio round in total; this does not invoke the OpenMath skill's eight-hour campaign protocol.

resource_guard.required_for: all proof searches, enumeration scripts, solvers, and formal builds

ranked_candidates.exact_target: Construct five distinct positive integers N_i having at least five common factor differences, or rigorously show why the tested k=4 extension mechanism reaches a genuine Diophantine obstruction.
ranked_candidates.first_kill_test: Search for a K_{5,5} in the exact square-offset incidence y^2-d^2=4N, independently verify every reported factor pair, and stop if the candidate-generation frontier grows without producing a reusable parametric invariant.
ranked_candidates.closure_scope: A construction proves the previously unknown k=5 case, a genuine scoped theorem but not the all-k conjecture.

ranked_candidates.exact_target: Factor the two-positive-cubes representation count through Eisenstein integers and determine exactly which prime-power choices remain after positivity and conjugation identifications.
ranked_candidates.first_kill_test: Derive and test the local multiplicity formula on exhaustive small n and known taxicab numbers; freeze the route if it collapses to the unrestricted divisor function without a coupling condition strong enough for a polylogarithmic bound.
ranked_candidates.closure_scope: A uniform polylogarithmic local-choice bound would close the public statement; a correct exact divisor-discriminant formula is scoped progress only.

ranked_candidates.exact_target: For edge-critical 6-chromatic graphs, reduce the desired f_6(n) <= (1/4+o(1))n^2 bound to an explicit finite family of stable witness-colouring configurations, or isolate the first non-finite structural bridge.
ranked_candidates.first_kill_test: Write the exact edge-witness colouring lemma and test whether regularity reduction preserves enough edge-by-edge criticality. Stop if the reduced graph loses the witness data and no bounded annotation repairs it.
ranked_candidates.closure_scope: A valid stability reduction plus finite classification would close the still-open k=6 asymptotic question.

ranked_candidates.exact_target: Determine exactly which parameters (d_1,d_2,k) inherit the known non-existence of r_3(2,3) under affine or padding transformations.
ranked_candidates.first_kill_test: Audit the universal quantifier over every bounded-gap A. Freeze immediately if the transformation covers only a subclass of allowed A or if the shift of kA depends on A.
ranked_candidates.closure_scope: A valid transfer settles additional parameter cases; a no-go theorem only closes this proposed route.
ranked_candidates.dynamic_status_note: An August 2026 public repository claims a paper-backed, sorry-free Lean proof of a complete dichotomy for the exact statement. It was not independently built in this round, but the claim is sufficient to stop fresh discovery and route the target to resolution audit.

The repository already contains multiple finite-hypergraph and fractional-certificate rounds; repeating them violates the new-problem objective.
A fixed public Lean commit has already built locally without sorry/admit/custom axioms and the exact public scope has passed independent mathematical review.
